conclusion: The user's hypothesis direction is CONTRADICTED in this sample. The strategy annualises +3.74% when SPY is above its 200-day and +9.81% when below; it earns -1.23% in calm volatility and +7.40% in stressed. Raising exposure in 'favourable' regimes would raise it exactly where the strategy performs worst. The strategy underperforms SPY in EVERY regime state. The timing drag is roughly CONSTANT across regimes (-0.433% to -0.601% per dollar, a 1.4x spread) while the selection edge varies 6x (+0.072% calm to +0.448% stressed), so regime conditioning does not explain the timing drag - it explains the selection edge. Two states are net negative: market 5-10% off its high (-$2,779) and calm volatility (-$1,949), both with near-zero selection edge. Capacity is not strongly regime-dependent (13.3% vs 17.2% conversion). No experiment registered.
